acceptance.requirement: MV-IA-F025 remains primary inherited onboarding/help/support authority
All nine F025 roles remain represented and Player, Game Master and Content Creator are primary human teaching audiences
Teaching content has stable IDs, versions, governing sources and provenance
Permission filtering precedes help/topic discovery, examples, tutorials, diagnostics, exports, notifications and AI
Hidden information cannot leak through counts, ranking, disabled options, missing-topic wording, tutorial branches or diagnostics
Local draft, autosave, authoritative save, submitted command, accepted Event and displayed projection remain distinct
Offline teaching never implies authoritative mutation
PPIA-14 retains complete final error/recovery/permission microcopy ownership
F024 Pack-lifecycle absence remains an explicit source gap; missing semantics are not invented
Tutorial-Campaign fixtures remain synthetic and noncanonical
Mobile, keyboard, touch, screen-reader, high-zoom, reduced-motion and noncolor delivery preserve required semantics
Thirty deterministic Foundation cases cover first use through recovery/tutorial edge paths
Generated/AI teaching cannot widen authority or become gameplay truth
Return context and Help rediscovery survive optional dismissal/replay
No application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, tester, paid-service or production activation occurs
